top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Medication was not kept or stored in the original container for a child in care.

top_violation_types.title: HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - Not Listed (26 TAC §HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - No)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Regular care is being provided to 2 unrelated children.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is missing how they would evacuate children younger then 24 months out of the operation doing an emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregivers were unaware that one child in their care was missing.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Recited: Four out of five staff files did not have the 24-hour pre-service training available for review.

top_violation_types.title: 746.5533 carbon monoxide detection system installed (26 TAC §746.5533)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The carbon monoxide detector in the main building was without a battery.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The staff stated that the permit holder is aware of the physical state that the classroom walls and floors are in. They stated that they are no longer accredited as a result and that work orders have been put in, but no repairs have been completed.
